Render blocker fixed: empty scene image path became Path('')=='.' whose exists() is True, so FFmpeg ran `-i .` and died 'Permission denied'. Guard in export_engine (empty -> descriptive early error, is_file() rejects directories, logs the resolved path); images stage now warns loudly when a script image isn't found instead of storing NULL silently; _scene_for_render self-heals from image_filename + images folder.

Natural pauses & human pacing: new core/narration_pacing.py is the single source of truth for inter-line narration silence, replacing the flat 0.25s gap. Context-aware durations (punctuation class, emotion, speaker/scene change), breathing-aware widening, deterministic CRC32 jitter, anti-stacking (authored [PAUSE] tags + PHASE 5 paragraph batches), anti-robotic-rhythm nudge, excessive-silence guard and absolute clamps. One plan is shared by core_engine (word-timestamp offsets), audio_processor (build_narration_track pause_plan) and timeline_engine (scene durations), so subtitle/image sync is preserved exactly. Fully backward compatible: app_settings.natural_pauses_enabled=false restores Phase 1-5 behavior.

phases.summary: Defensive programming & reliability: new core/safe_io.py gives every layer crash-safe atomic writes (unique temp file + fsync + retrying os.replace), corrupt-file quarantine and stale-temp purging. Config, cache index, cache entries, narration/line WAVs, processed images and proxies, SRT sidecars, YouTube metadata, Drive resume state, pronunciation dictionaries and storyboard PDFs are now written atomically. FFmpeg processes are always reaped (terminate -> kill -> wait) and their stderr tail is reported on failure; partial render outputs and orphaned group/mux temp files are cleaned up. SQLite gains busy-retry, broken-connection recovery, an all-or-nothing transaction helper for script persistence, atomic backups and close_all(). Cancel now drains thread pools promptly, MemoryError is handled per stage, and log/cache folders degrade to a writable fallback instead of blocking boot. No behavior from Phases 1-8 changed.
